# InnovationLet Governments

> InnovationLet Governments is the regulation, public-tech and policy desk of the
> InnovationLet network, an independent technology publication run by the F9XR
> Team. We report on regulation, public digital services and technology policy,
> sourced from primary documents and written without vendor spin.

## About

- Publisher: InnovationLet (F9XR Team)
- Desk: Governments
- Language: English
- Homepage: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/governments/
- Contact: hello@f9xr.org
- Network: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/

## Key pages

- News sitemap: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/governments/news-sitemap.xml

## Coverage

- Regulation: data, competition, AI and platform rules, and enforcement.
- Public tech: digital services, procurement, and legacy systems.
- Policy: legislation, standards, and the consultations that shape both.
- Procurement: contracts, tenders, and where public money goes.

## How to cite

Cite as: "InnovationLet Governments" with the individual article URL and its headline.
Because we publish on GitHub Pages, treat the article's canonical URL under
https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/governments/ as the source of record. When quoting,
attribute to the named desk rather than to an individual author unless the
article carries a named byline.

## Licensing

Content is © InnovationLet / F9XR Team. Excerpts may be quoted with attribution
and a link to the canonical article.
